defects_remediated.description: Doctor discount button clipped as '% Скид...' against modal right edge in 1440x900 PC view
defects_remediated.root_cause: Redundant horizontal padding (sm:px-6) + wide label strings ('Инструменты врача:', 'Клинические пакеты') + double percent symbol (<Percent /> icon + '% Скидка' text) exceeding 1320px modal container width
remediation: apps/web/src/components/treatment-plans/presenterTools/PresenterToolsButtonsBar.tsx: changed default discountLabel to 'Скидка' (rendering clean '% Скидка' with Lucide Percent icon), shortened 'Инструменты врача:' to 'Инструменты:', shortened 'Клинические пакеты' to 'Пакеты', purged hardcoded hex colors to CSS design tokens (var(--paper-strong), var(--ink), var(--line), var(--teal)), added shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap

apps/web/src/components/treatment-plans/presenterHeader/PresenterHeaderNavRow.tsx: removed redundant sm:px-6 inner padding, added pr-3 to toolsBarSlot container for guaranteed breathing room before modal boundary
defects_remediated.verification: treatment_plans_pc_light_1440x900.png and treatment_plans_pc_dark_1440x900.png inspected via read_file; button '% Скидка' is 100% visible with ~20px clearance

defects_remediated.description: Hardcoded hex colors (#ffffff, #0f172a, #0d9488, #cbd5e1) in presenter toolbar and comparison components
defects_remediated.remediation: Replaced all raw hex literals with canonical CSS tokens: var(--paper-strong), var(--paper-soft), var(--ink), var(--line), var(--teal)
defects_remediated.verification: Zero hardcoded hex color violations in presenter toolbar components

defects_remediated.description: Mobile presenter footer had flex-direction: column-reverse placing summary text below action buttons
defects_remediated.remediation: apps/web/src/components/treatment-plans/styles/mobilePresenterFooterOverrides.css: updated to flex-direction: column to ensure natural visual hierarchy (summary first, primary CTA second, auxiliary actions third)
defects_remediated.verification: treatment_plans_mobile_light_390x844.png and treatment_plans_mobile_dark_390x844.png inspected via read_file
